name: time-sleeper
title: Time Sleeper
description: Put your Mac to sleep after a countdown timer. Choose from preset delays (1s, 5s, 10s) with visual countdown and cancel anytime.
author: radaman

commands.name: sleep-in-1s
commands.title: Sleep in 1S
commands.description: Put Mac to sleep in 1 second

commands.name: sleep-in-5s
commands.title: Sleep in 5S
commands.description: Put Mac to sleep in 5 seconds with countdown

commands.name: sleep-in-10s
commands.title: Sleep in 10S
commands.description: Put Mac to sleep in 10 seconds with countdown

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
